strategy_roster.name: Neuro Nirvaman MQ4
strategy_roster.notes: The Laguerre-filtered +DI streams, perceptrons and supervisor have no DSL equivalent, so the SilverTrend(7) breakout is combined with the documented ADX period 14 as the strength gate (25/20 are stated defaults). The 100/50-point take-profit and stop and the perceptron weights cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: Bread and Butter 2 (ADX + AMA)
strategy_roster.notes: Kaufman AMA(9) is approximated by EMA(9) (the 2/30 adaptive constants are dropped), and the documented long rule of weakening ADX with improving momentum plus its inverse becomes the exit using the ADX(14) change. The 50/50-pip stop and target are price units, so SL/TP stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Serial MA Swing Strategy (API/2782)
strategy_roster.notes: The custom SerialMA average that rebuilds from each crossover is not computable, so a 20-bar SMA (stated default) supplies the crossover flag and the long signal fires on the documented upward cross. ReverseSignals, swing stacking modes and point-based stop/target are engine features, not DSL ones.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci Trend
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 50% retracement of the swing range is built from a 20-bar Donchian high/low (the docs name no lookback value) and traded on the cross in each direction. Fib levels 1-5 beyond the 50% and the swing-confirmation filter are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Stopreversal Tm
strategy_roster.notes: The dynamic trailing boundary is approximated by an EMA(20) offset with the documented sensitivity nPips = 0.004 (0.4%), so a cross above it is the long reversal entry and the mirror cross the exit. The session time filter, SignalBar delay and applied-price modes are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Close At Profit
strategy_roster.notes: Documented as a protective overlay that watches realized PnL (20 currency units profit, 100 loss) and cancels orders, explicitly without analysing indicators or price. The never-true guard is used since no market-derived entry exists.

strategy_roster.name: LANZ Strategy 6.0 [Backtest]
strategy_roster.notes: A schedule-driven backtest that trades the fixed 09:00 New York one-hour candle and flattens at 15:00 New York, with no documented price or indicator condition and no parameter values. The never-true guard is used instead of inventing a signal.

strategy_roster.name: Tripple MACD
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(macd(close,12,26),0) and close > open and rsi(close,14) < 55
strategy_roster.notes: The average of four MACD sets is approximated by a single MACD(12,26) histogram since no lengths are documented, keeping the bullish-candle requirement and the RSI cap of 55. The opposite condition (bearish histogram turn on a down candle) supplies the exit.

strategy_roster.name: Price Convergence
strategy_roster.notes: The OHLC4-weighted rise/fall probability is approximated by the fraction of bullish candles over the documented Range = 200 window, entered above 50% and exited below. The OHLC4 weighting and the full-history option are not representable, so the rolling window is used.

strategy_roster.name: Bj Candle Patterns
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (close - open) < 0.1 * (high - low) and (open - low) > 2 * (close - open)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < open and (open - close) < 0.1 * (high - low) and (high - close) > 2 * (open - close)
strategy_roster.notes: A Dragonfly Doji is a small bullish body (documented DojiThreshold 0.1 of the range) with a lower shadow more than twice the body, and the mirrored Gravestone Doji is the documented opposite-signal exit. The 15-minute candle type and discretionary exit are dropped.
